rows.caveat: Matched before/after comparison. Describes households linked to a fan account (mostly North American), not all participants. Synthetic data.

Analyst detail only. Pools in accounts the programme itself created, whose households are less engaged than the average fan, which pulls the average down: its direction is not the direction of the selection bias. Not a valid estimate. Linked households only.

The naive companion of the matched estimate: the same kind of household (one that already had a fan account), compared with unlinked accounts without matching. Not a valid estimate: households that enroll were already more engaged, so it overstates. Linked households only.
